title: Consolidated Console Insights MVP: rebaseline dashboards, tracing, and cost breakdown
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Deliver a tightly scoped Console Insights MVP that gives engineering teams quick signal on service health (latency/error), basic trace navigation, and a high-level cost breakdown by route. We must reduce scope from the previous PRD to meet the Q1 cadence while keeping clear acceptance criteria and a minimal UX that is useful to customers.
background: Previous PRD included: multi-card dashboards, per-token cost drilldowns, full distributed trace waterfall, customizable query builder, and integrated alerts. Engineering and design capacity constraints plus enterprise launch priorities force us to rebaseline. This ticket captures the agreed cuts and the remaining surface needed for a coherent first release.
scope_changes: Removed: per-token cost explorer and CSV export (postpone to subsequent release)
Removed: full trace waterfall with service-level spans — replace with sampled trace links and single-span highlight
Reduced: dashboard card count limited to 3 canonical cards (latency, error rate, 7-day cost by route)
Reduced: time-range support to fixed presets (1h, 24h, 7d) — postpone arbitrary date ranges
Removed: alerts and on-console anomaly detection (will integrate with external alerting in follow-ups)
scope_remaining: Canonical dashboard with 3 cards: p50/p95 latency, error rate, and aggregated 7-day cost by route
Trace sampling link: from a latency card, open a sampled trace viewer that shows request summary and links to raw trace in Trace UI
Cost breakdown: roll-up by route with toggle between absolute cost and cost per 1k requests
Lightweight drill: clicking a route filters the dashboard and surfaces the top 3 contributing models (if available)
Basic export: PNG snapshot of dashboard view (no CSVs for launch)
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Dashboard renders within 1s for 95% of requests in staging for workspace with <100k requests/day
AC2: Latency card shows p50 and p95 with correct sampling and matches raw telemetry within ±5%
AC3: Error rate card aggregates 500/4xx/5xx consistently and supports 1h/24h/7d presets
AC4: Cost card aggregates token and instance-based costs and groups by route; numbers reconcile with billing dashboard within ±10%
AC5: From latency p95 spike, user can open a sampled trace link that loads a trace summary within 2s and links to the full Trace UI
AC6: Dashboard UI passes accessibility smoke check (keyboard nav + screen reader labels on core controls)
AC7: Snapshot export works and produces legible PNGs for all three cards
AC8: Feature gated behind 'insights-mvp' flag and can be toggled per-organization in staging
decisions: Decision: Defer per-token drilldown and CSV export to reduce backend cost and schema work
Decision: Use sampled trace links instead of full distributed tracing to limit storage and UI complexity
Decision: Keep cost roll-up to 7-day granularity for MVP to simplify aggregation and reduce query load
Decision: Expose feature under feature-flag for controlled rollouts and fast rollback
risks: Users will ask for per-token and export capabilities at launch — plan comms and clear roadmap
Aggregation mismatch vs billing could create trust issues; need reconciliation tests
Sampling may hide root cause for some latency issues — require clear documentation of sampling limits
qa_steps: Deploy feature-flagged build to staging org 'insights-staging'
Run synthetic traffic (latency and error patterns) and validate dashboard numbers match telemetry pipeline
Validate trace link opens sampled trace and the Trace UI link resolves
Confirm PNG export contains all visible cards and is readable at 2x scaling
Run accessibility checklist: tab order, ARIA labels, color contrast
follow_ups: F1: Add per-token cost explorer and CSV export (Q2 work)
F2: Expand trace viewer to show full waterfall and span-level details (post-MVP)
F3: Add alerting integration with Observability platform
F4: Increase time-range flexibility and custom ranges
